description: Phase 2. FDB parity: recovery never rewrites the mapping (ClusterRecovery writes it only via seedShardServers for a brand-new database). Persistence stops the blanket clear+rewrite of shard_keys/ and materializers/: shard_keys seeds only-when-absent (boundaries never change without splits); materializers seeds-when-absent and writes exactly the entries this recovery CHANGED (bootstrap re-assignments), never clearing untouched entries. Tag-0 carve-out: the metadata shard stays recovery's to seed/heal (stall-only-for-tag-0). Bootstrap keeps creating workers for uncovered data tags until phase 4 shifts that to the distributor. Bootstrap's re-adoption input is the durable materializers/ family.
title: Recovery reads-and-heals the mapping families; seed-only-when-absent
